text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The governor of Sabinda province Amaro Tati dismissed press reports of Angolan soldiers crossing into Zaire over the weekend. Tati said he visited the border town of Yema and spoke with Zairean military and immigration authorities. He said everything there appeared to be normal.
- The normalisation of state administration begins on Wednesday in M'banza Congo.
- The Namibian minig company Namco plans to ijvest in Angola. The president of the firm was in Luanda last week meeting with Endiama officials.
